fatal_errors: No method is identified; the target intervention is high-energy ball milling followed by spark plasma sintering.
The material system and all processing conditions are unspecified.
No mechanism connects processing, phase stability, nanocrystalline refinement, and mechanical properties.
No quantitative phase, microstructure, density, hardness, or strength predictions are provided.
The proposed systematic review is not a discriminating experimental test of the materials hypothesis.
explanation: The hypothesis only restates that an unspecified method exists and therefore does not reconstruct or substantively answer the question. It misses the CoCrFeNiTi powder system, HEBM/SPS processing sequence, critical milling and sintering conditions, FCC/BCC phase balance, nanocrystalline strengthening mechanisms, quantitative outcomes, baseline comparison, and process boundaries. Its falsification rule is too broad and literature-dependent to distinguish the target processing mechanism.
